WRECK ROUTE
A demolition path-clearing vertical slice

A volatile mega-carrier is rolling through Sector 7. Clear every structure on its lane before it arrives — or the whole district goes with it.

Ram Dozer — smash buildings by ramming at speed
Pendulum Crane — swing the wrecking ball (SMASH)
Optional: smash all radar dishes for a bonus medal
